findings: Both launcher scripts carry Apache-2.0 notices independent of the root GPL license; retain file-level licensing if any launcher content is reused. No code was adopted.

POSIX launcher resolves its own symlinks, quotes accumulated command arguments and launches GradleWrapperMain from the local wrapper JAR. Environment option parsing explicitly documents unsupported newline/unmatched-quote cases.
Windows launcher performs its own Java lookup and delegates percent-star arguments to java.exe. It was source-read only, not executed under Windows.
No duplicate matching logic is present in these launchers. Shell syntax validation alone does not qualify Gradle, Kotlin compilation, release packaging or Android behavior.
